oil.when: 2017–2019 with the Mazda Connect center display (Applications > Vehicle Status Monitor)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Park and switch the ignition ON so the center display comes up.
From the home screen, select the Applications icon, then select Vehicle Status Monitor.
Select Maintenance, switch to the Oil Change tab and select Reset. The remaining distance or oil life goes back to its starting value.
If the oil change setting on that tab is Fixed or Off (not Flexible), also do the engine control unit reset: with the ignition OFF, press and hold the dashboard illumination knob.
Keep holding the knob, switch the ignition ON, and keep pressing for more than 7 seconds before letting go.
oil.note: The Flexible setting, where the car works out oil life from how it is driven, is offered only in the US and Puerto Rico. Checked in the 2017 (US) and 2019 (European edition) owner's manuals, which show the same steps.

notes: Reset the oil reminder every time the oil is changed, even if the wrench light has not come on yet.
